# attested in context

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:attestedInContext`](gmeow-attestedInContext.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedInContext>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The corpus, platform, community, dataset, inscription, or broader context in which the attested form was observed. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a form may be attested in multiple contexts simultaneously, and context assignments are standpoint-scoped.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:attestedInContext`](gmeow-attestedInContext.md) from [`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a [`UsageAttestation`](../classes/gmeow-UsageAttestation.md) to name the corpus, platform, community, dataset, or inscription context in which the form was observed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid treating context as the asserting standpoint (it is deliberately not subsumed under vantage — context is where it was seen, not who claims it) and avoid using it for the bibliographic source ([`gmeow:attestedInSource`](gmeow-attestedInSource.md)).

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:attestedInContext`](gmeow-attestedInContext.md) at one or more [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) contexts; multiple coexisting contexts on one attestation are expected, and the asserting standpoint stays on the vantage axis.

### Examples

- ex:att1 [`gmeow:attestedInContext`](gmeow-attestedInContext.md) ex:chaucerCorpus.
